info.title: ZecBlock API v1
info.summary: Versioned, contract-stable read/write API for the Zcash blockchain data and privacy-intelligence features exposed by ZecBlock.
info.description: This is the v1 contract layer. It is gated behind API_V1_ENABLED and, pre-launch, an X-API-Preview-Key header (see the previewKey security scheme) — see server/api/v1/README.md in the repository for exact mount instructions and current caveats. Every success response uses the {data, meta} envelope; every error response is an RFC 9457 problem+json document. Every public inventory entry is adapted; The manifest explicitly identifies retained operational routes and payment-protected services.

previewKey.name: X-API-Preview-Key
previewKey.description: Required while API_V1_LAUNCHED=false. Dropped once v1 is generally available.
